tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Dark section grounds, primary buttons on Paper, the logo on light grounds. Never pure #000.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand paper. Default page ground and text on Ink. Never pure #fff as a page ground.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Raised cards and visual frames on Paper; the button fill on Ink.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper and white (5.4:1 / 6.0:1). Not on ink.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink and carbon (7.1:1 / 6.4:1). Not on paper.

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Raised panels and visual frames inside Ink sections.

tokens.name: hairline-paper
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card rules on paper. Decorative only — never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: hairline-ink
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and step rules on ink. Decorative only.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The accent on ink and carbon (8.9:1 / 8.2:1). Never as text on paper or white (2.0:1).

tokens.name: brass-deep
tokens.usage: The accent on paper and white (5.3:1 / 6.0:1). Never on ink (3.3:1).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Illustration-only tone for metallic renders and diagram fills. Never text, never UI state.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Section ground. Paper sections and Ink sections alternate down the page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Visual frames, cards and inputs sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The opposite ground, e.g. a dark visual tile inside a Paper section.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥17:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Intros, card copy, eyebrows and meta on `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥5.4:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px section and card rules. Structure, not meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outline controls on `surface` (≥3:1 both themes).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Ink on Paper, White on Ink — always the strongest contrast available.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and arrow on `action`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: section and card indices, the active nav underline, arrows on hover, one highlighted word or period per view. Text-safe on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes (≥5.3:1). Never a button fill, never a large area outside illustrations.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 3px offset on every interactive element (≥17:1 on `surface`).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. Mobile: 47/51.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Wir verbinden Websites, Marketing und KI.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Wir hören zu und definieren, was dein Projekt erreichen soll.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows and tag lists, uppercase. Always `text-secondary`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to rule.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button icon gap; title to body in cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; card text blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; grid gap in cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop grid gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Heading to content in a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (1440px frame).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Mobile section padding top/bottom.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding top/bottom.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, inputs, visuals. GRAVN is square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only for dots and status discs inside illustrations.

size.note: Fixed dimensions that are not spacing.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule and divider.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Desktop header bar; 64px below 768px.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max layout width; content inset by `space-8`.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of intro and body paragraphs.
